_comment: Floor passages: a cell that moves whoever stops on it to another map. For the maps that
need a way out and have no element to hang a passage off -- the client only lets a
player click what its own map data has (see teleports.json). Nothing is declared to the
client, so the cell looks like any other: put one only where the map's drawing already
A cell that already has an element's passage keeps that one. This is a file of its own
and not a list in teleports.json because Jondo Studio's passage editor rewrites that
file whole, with only the passages it knows.
